parameters.description: Start of the planned-date window (YYYY-MM-DD). When start_date and end_date are omitted, provider-side workouts default to the trailing 30 days; pass an explicit window to list upcoming workouts.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: End of the planned-date window (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.
parameters.name: end_date

items.description: A workout template scheduled onto a user's calendar

anyOf.description: Athlete-specific metrics used to personalise workout targets for one planned workout

pool_length_meters.description: Pool length in meters (overrides the template value)

coercion_warnings.description: Warnings emitted when the template could not be represented exactly on the provider

anyOf.description: Full body of a provider-side planned workout, fetched live from the provider. Present only on external planned workouts (is_external true), which have no Terra workout template.
Summary metadata of a provider-side planned workout

created_date.description: Creation time on the provider's side (RFC 3339)

description.description: Workout description, when the provider exposes one

id.description: Identifier of the workout on the provider's side

planned_date.description: Scheduled date (YYYY-MM-DD), matching the list item's planned_date

provider.description: Provider the workout was fetched from

type.description: Numeric activity type of the workout

items.description: A step of a provider-side planned workout
Completion condition of a provider planned-workout step
A step of a provider-side planned workout

steps.description: Child steps of a repetition block

items.description: Intensity target of a provider planned-workout step

steps.description: Structured steps of the workout, when the provider exposes them

details.description: Full workout body (title, description, planned metrics, structured steps) fetched live from the provider. Present only for external workouts (is_external true).

is_external.description: True when the workout was created on the provider side rather than through Terra

planned_workout_id.description: Terra identifier of the planned workout

provider_workout_id.description: Identifier of the workout on the provider's side, once pushed

workout_id.description: Identifier of the workout template this was planned from. Absent for workouts created on the provider side.

schema.description: An error response, following RFC 9457 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs, which obsoletes RFC 7807). Returned with `Content-Type: application/problem+json` on every 4xx/5xx response. The HTTP status line carries the status code; it is intentionally not repeated in the body. `type`, `title` and `instance` are always present; `detail` is included when a specific explanation is available.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
detail.example: dev-id or x-api-key headers are missing

instance.description: The request path, including any query string, that produced this problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type (the lowercased HTTP status text).

type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type. Defaults to `about:blank`.

400.description: One or more parameters is malformed. The `detail` field describes the specific problem.

example.detail: dev-id or x-api-key headers are missing
example.title: unauthorized
